summary: This tutorial covers how to customize the appearance of JChemPaint, a chemical structure editor. It starts by welcoming users to the features of JChemPaint and explaining how to change the background color of the panel. Users can access this feature via the Edit menu, then Preferences, and select the Background Color option from the FireFox Preferences window. They can choose from various color options depending on their operating system. The tutorial also explains how to change the look and feel of the application by selecting Nimbus from the Look and Feel dropdown menu in the Preferences window. Additionally, it guides users on changing the user interface language from English to another supported language like Spanish. Finally, the tutorial demonstrates how to include templates in JChemPaint, which can be accessed through the Templates menu or the side toolbar, showing various structure templates available in the Structure Templates window.
